title: Leaderboard
metaDescription: Module leaderboards for today, this week and all time — who finished what, and where your own score sits.
description: One module and one period at a time, exactly as scores are counted. Only players who chose to appear publicly are listed.
boardDescription: Scope: {period}. Each row is a player's accepted total for this period.
tableCaption: {module} leaderboard for {period}: rank, player and score

empty.title: This board is still warming up
empty.body: No {module} scores have landed in this period yet — the clock is running and the board is yours to set.

notes.policy: Only players who chose to appear publicly are listed.
notes.viewerAway: You are not in the top {count} for this period yet.
notes.guest: Guest play counts towards your own record but does not appear on boards.
notes.signIn: Sign in to take a place

unavailable.title: This board did not load
unavailable.body: The leaderboard read did not come back, so no rows are shown instead of an empty table.

how.title: How boards work
how.scores: A board adds up every accepted score you set on that module during the selected period.
how.visibility: Your name and score appear only while your public visibility setting is on.
how.boards: Score boards run for every module: today, this week, and all time.
